This report contains **only current results**: produced with the current model
code and comparable with one another. Past experiments whose results are out
of date or not comparable are listed (without their results) in
`sim/archive/README.md`. Metric definitions are in `docs/evaluation_metrics.md`;
the design question behind the misaligned study is discussed in
`docs/supervision_regimes.md`.

**Which model.** All current simulation results are for the **shared-factor
model** (`SupMultiviewShared`). The full model, VIPER (`SupMultiviewDecomp`, with
view-specific factors), has no current results yet (section 3).

**Methods.** Every section compares the same methods, as in the TCGA analysis:
the shared model, MOFA + OLS, PCA + OLS (5 and 15 components), ridge and elastic
net, plus oracles where the truth is known.

## 1. Current studies

| Study | Methods | Data | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Misaligned scenarios | shared model and MOFA (June 2026 runs); PCA + OLS, ridge, elastic net, oracles (October 2026) | `sim/data/multi_view_shared_misaligned`: 12 (n, p) cells × 4 scenarios × 10 replicates | current; covariance metric pending correction |
| Single-condition pipeline runs | shared model; single-view model | one dataset each | current: `sim/python_integration.html`, `sim/python_factorization.html` |

## 2. Misaligned scenarios

**Design** (from the methods document). Five shared factors; the outcome
depends only on some of them, which are given smaller loadings:

| Scenario | Factor scales $(s_1,\dots,s_5)$ | Outcome factors |
|---|---|---|
| symmetric | (1, 1, 1, 1, 1) | all |
| mild misalignment | (2, 2, 1, 1, 1) | 3, 4, 5 |
| strong misalignment | (3, 2, 1, 0.5, 0.25) | 4, 5 |
| anti-aligned | (3, 2, 1, 0.5, 0.25) | 5 only |

The full analysis, with every metric for every (n, p) cell, is
`sim/exploration/misaligned_diagnosis.qmd`. The headline tables follow; all are
per (scenario, n, p) cell.

```{python}
import os
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Image, display

SUMMARY = os.path.expanduser("~/multiomic_integration/sim/results/integration_shared_misaligned/summary")
FIGS    = os.path.expanduser("~/multiomic_integration/sim/figures/misaligned")
OUT     = os.path.expanduser("~/multiomic_integration/sim/results/summary")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

def show(name):
    path = os.path.join(SUMMARY, name)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        print(f"{name} not found: render sim/exploration/misaligned_diagnosis.qmd first")
        return None
    t = pd.read_csv(path, index_col=[0, 1, 2])
    t.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, f"misaligned_{name}"))
    return t
```

### Is the outcome factor detectable without supervision?

Median strength of the weakest outcome-relevant factor relative to the detection
threshold $\sqrt{P/n}$ (above 1: an unsupervised method can find it).

```{python}
path = os.path.join(SUMMARY, "detection_ratio_by_cell.csv")
pd.read_csv(path, index_col=[0, 1]) if os.path.exists(path) else print("not found")
```

### Test outcome MSE

```{python}
show("outcome_mse_by_cell.csv")
```

```{python}
if os.path.exists(os.path.join(FIGS, "outcome_mse_by_cell.png")):
    display(Image(os.path.join(FIGS, "outcome_mse_by_cell.png")))
```

### Best method per cell

Lowest mean test MSE among the fitted methods, and the shared model's rank (1 = best of 6).

```{python}
path = os.path.join(SUMMARY, "best_method_by_cell.csv")
if os.path.exists(path):
    best = pd.read_csv(path, index_col=[0, 1, 2])
    best.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "misaligned_best_method_by_cell.csv"))
    display(best.unstack("p"))
```

show("gap_to_oracle_by_cell.csv")
